                                                Integrate Aurora through the Vercel Marketplace

                                                1. Installing the Aurora Integration
                                                2. Connecting to your Vercel projects
                                                3. Configuring your Aurora application
                                                4. Pricing
                                                5. Limitations
                                                Open inOpen in ChatGPT

                                                The Vercel Marketplace allows Vercel users to install and configure third-party services, like Aurora, directly from the Vercel dashboard. Aurora offers an official integration⁠ that Vercel users can install to integrate Aurora into their Vercel projects.

                                                Installing the Aurora Integration

                                                Tip

                                                Deploy an example Next.js application and install the Aurora integration with our template.

                                                1. Navigate to the Aurora integration⁠ in the Vercel Marketplace.
                                                2. Click Install to add Aurora to your Vercel team.
                                                3. Select your pricing plan.
                                                4. Provide a name for your Aurora application.
                                                5. Click Create.

                                                Vercel will automatically provision a Aurora account, Organization, and application for you. Vercel calls the provisioned application a Resource.

                                                Each Vercel team has an associated Aurora Organization. When you open the Aurora Dashboard from the Vercel Marketplace, Aurora will automatically provision a new account for you, or link to an existing Aurora account if an account is found with the same email address. An equivalent role in Aurora is assigned to the user based on their Vercel team role. Roles and Vercel team membership are automatically synced to Aurora.

                                                Connecting to your Vercel projects

                                                Once you've installed and provisioned a Aurora application, you will need to connect it to one of your Vercel projects. Generally, a Aurora application should be connected to a single Vercel project. Aurora will manage multiple instances for you that map to Vercel's environments: Aurora's development instance maps to Vercel's development and preview environments, and the production instance maps to Vercel's production environment.

                                                Connecting to a project will automatically sync your Aurora API keys to your Vercel project's environment variables. The following environment variables will be automatically synced to each environment:

                                                Tip

                                                Running vercel env pull in your project will automatically sync the development environment variables locally.

                                                Configuring your Aurora application

                                                Most of your Aurora application configuration will be done through the Aurora Dashboard. To access the Dashboard after installing the Aurora integration, navigate to your installation details page and click the Open in Aurora button.

                                                Refer to the Configuration documentation for more information on configuring your application.

                                                Pricing

                                                The pricing for plans and add-ons purchased through the Vercel Marketplace is the same as the pricing when purchased directly through Aurora. For more information on Aurora's pricing and available plans, see the pricing page.

                                                Billing and usage data are reported hourly to Vercel and can be viewed directly in the Vercel Dashboard.

                                                Limitations

                                                The following limitations apply when using Aurora through the Vercel Marketplace:

                                                • Vercel-managed Organizations cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Aurora integration.
                                                • Vercel-managed Applications cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Resource from the Vercel Dashboard.
                                                • Additional Applications cannot be created from the Aurora Dashboard, they must be created from the Vercel Dashboard.
                                                • Billing and plan management is done through the Vercel Dashboard.
                                                • Existing Aurora applications cannot be connected to or moved to be managed by the Aurora Integration.

                                                Feedback

                                                What did you think of this content?

                                                Last updated on Sep 11, 2026

Integrate Aurora through the Vercel Marketplace

Open inOpen in ChatGPT

The Vercel Marketplace allows Vercel users to install and configure third-party services, like Aurora, directly from the Vercel dashboard. Aurora offers an official integration⁠ that Vercel users can install to integrate Aurora into their Vercel projects.

Installing the Aurora Integration

Tip

Deploy an example Next.js application and install the Aurora integration with our template.

  1. Navigate to the Aurora integration⁠ in the Vercel Marketplace.
  2. Click Install to add Aurora to your Vercel team.
  3. Select your pricing plan.
  4. Provide a name for your Aurora application.
  5. Click Create.

Vercel will automatically provision a Aurora account, Organization, and application for you. Vercel calls the provisioned application a Resource.

Each Vercel team has an associated Aurora Organization. When you open the Aurora Dashboard from the Vercel Marketplace, Aurora will automatically provision a new account for you, or link to an existing Aurora account if an account is found with the same email address. An equivalent role in Aurora is assigned to the user based on their Vercel team role. Roles and Vercel team membership are automatically synced to Aurora.

Connecting to your Vercel projects

Once you've installed and provisioned a Aurora application, you will need to connect it to one of your Vercel projects. Generally, a Aurora application should be connected to a single Vercel project. Aurora will manage multiple instances for you that map to Vercel's environments: Aurora's development instance maps to Vercel's development and preview environments, and the production instance maps to Vercel's production environment.

Connecting to a project will automatically sync your Aurora API keys to your Vercel project's environment variables. The following environment variables will be automatically synced to each environment:

Tip

Running vercel env pull in your project will automatically sync the development environment variables locally.

Configuring your Aurora application

Most of your Aurora application configuration will be done through the Aurora Dashboard. To access the Dashboard after installing the Aurora integration, navigate to your installation details page and click the Open in Aurora button.

Refer to the Configuration documentation for more information on configuring your application.

Pricing

The pricing for plans and add-ons purchased through the Vercel Marketplace is the same as the pricing when purchased directly through Aurora. For more information on Aurora's pricing and available plans, see the pricing page.

Billing and usage data are reported hourly to Vercel and can be viewed directly in the Vercel Dashboard.

Limitations

The following limitations apply when using Aurora through the Vercel Marketplace:

  • Vercel-managed Organizations cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Aurora integration.
  • Vercel-managed Applications cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Resource from the Vercel Dashboard.
  • Additional Applications cannot be created from the Aurora Dashboard, they must be created from the Vercel Dashboard.
  • Billing and plan management is done through the Vercel Dashboard.
  • Existing Aurora applications cannot be connected to or moved to be managed by the Aurora Integration.

What did you think of this content?

                                                Connecting to a project will automatically sync your Aurora API keys to your Vercel project's environment variables. The following environment variables will be automatically synced to each environment:

                                                Tip

                                                Running vercel env pull in your project will automatically sync the development environment variables locally.

                                                Configuring your Aurora application

                                                Most of your Aurora application configuration will be done through the Aurora Dashboard. To access the Dashboard after installing the Aurora integration, navigate to your installation details page and click the Open in Aurora button.

                                                Refer to the Configuration documentation for more information on configuring your application.

                                                Pricing

                                                The pricing for plans and add-ons purchased through the Vercel Marketplace is the same as the pricing when purchased directly through Aurora. For more information on Aurora's pricing and available plans, see the pricing page.

                                                Billing and usage data are reported hourly to Vercel and can be viewed directly in the Vercel Dashboard.

                                                Limitations

                                                The following limitations apply when using Aurora through the Vercel Marketplace:

                                                • Vercel-managed Organizations cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Aurora integration.
                                                • Vercel-managed Applications cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Resource from the Vercel Dashboard.
                                                • Additional Applications cannot be created from the Aurora Dashboard, they must be created from the Vercel Dashboard.
                                                • Billing and plan management is done through the Vercel Dashboard.
                                                • Existing Aurora applications cannot be connected to or moved to be managed by the Aurora Integration.

The Vercel Marketplace allows Vercel users to install and configure third-party services, like Aurora, directly from the Vercel dashboard. Aurora offers an official integration⁠ that Vercel users can install to integrate Aurora into their Vercel projects.

Installing the Aurora Integration

Tip

Deploy an example Next.js application and install the Aurora integration with our template.

  1. Navigate to the Aurora integration⁠ in the Vercel Marketplace.
  2. Click Install to add Aurora to your Vercel team.
  3. Select your pricing plan.
  4. Provide a name for your Aurora application.
  5. Click Create.

Vercel will automatically provision a Aurora account, Organization, and application for you. Vercel calls the provisioned application a Resource.

Each Vercel team has an associated Aurora Organization. When you open the Aurora Dashboard from the Vercel Marketplace, Aurora will automatically provision a new account for you, or link to an existing Aurora account if an account is found with the same email address. An equivalent role in Aurora is assigned to the user based on their Vercel team role. Roles and Vercel team membership are automatically synced to Aurora.

Connecting to your Vercel projects

Once you've installed and provisioned a Aurora application, you will need to connect it to one of your Vercel projects. Generally, a Aurora application should be connected to a single Vercel project. Aurora will manage multiple instances for you that map to Vercel's environments: Aurora's development instance maps to Vercel's development and preview environments, and the production instance maps to Vercel's production environment.

Connecting to a project will automatically sync your Aurora API keys to your Vercel project's environment variables. The following environment variables will be automatically synced to each environment:

Tip

Running vercel env pull in your project will automatically sync the development environment variables locally.

Configuring your Aurora application

Most of your Aurora application configuration will be done through the Aurora Dashboard. To access the Dashboard after installing the Aurora integration, navigate to your installation details page and click the Open in Aurora button.

Refer to the Configuration documentation for more information on configuring your application.

Pricing

The pricing for plans and add-ons purchased through the Vercel Marketplace is the same as the pricing when purchased directly through Aurora. For more information on Aurora's pricing and available plans, see the pricing page.

Billing and usage data are reported hourly to Vercel and can be viewed directly in the Vercel Dashboard.

Limitations

  • Vercel-managed Organizations cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Aurora integration.
  • Vercel-managed Applications cannot be deleted from the Aurora Dashboard, they can only be deleted by uninstalling the Resource from the Vercel Dashboard.
  • Additional Applications cannot be created from the Aurora Dashboard, they must be created from the Vercel Dashboard.
  • Billing and plan management is done through the Vercel Dashboard.
  • Existing Aurora applications cannot be connected to or moved to be managed by the Aurora Integration.
